SELECT users.id, users.display_name, users.avatar_url 
FROM users 
WHERE users.id != $1::UUID AND users.is_ghost IS false AND users.suspended_at IS NULL AND users.id IN (SELECT users.id 
FROM users 
WHERE users.id IN (SELECT memberships.user_id 
FROM memberships 
WHERE memberships.status = $2::VARCHAR AND memberships.chapter_id IN (SELECT memberships.chapter_id 
FROM memberships 
WHERE memberships.user_id = $3::UUID AND memberships.status = $4::VARCHAR)) OR users.campus_id = $5::UUID) AND users.display_name ILIKE $6::VARCHAR ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY users.display_name 
 LIMIT $7::INTEGER
